Hi Jacob — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today's discovery call: 

- SOC 2: Please confirm current status (Type I/II) and the most recent report date. You mentioned audit is in progress — an expected completion window would help us map any contractual language.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We discussed that FinHealth needs HIPAA controls for PHI flows. Can you confirm which data types would be sent to Redwood (tokens, metadata, attachments)?
- Pen test: FinHealth requested a copy of our most recent pen-test report and clarification on our vulnerability management cadence and SLAs. I've attached our standard pen-test request form and vendor security questionnaire to kick this off.

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-request-form.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx

Proposed next steps:
1) Jacob to confirm SOC 2 status and high-level data types by EOD Friday (9/11).
2) Amanda/Jacob to complete the vendor questionnaire and indicate any preferred NDA redaction requirements (we can provide an NDA).
3) We (Redwood) will outline our vuln management SLAs and scanning cadence and provide a sanitized pen-test report under NDA.

If that timeline looks good I'll follow up with the formal questionnaire + DocuSign NDA link.

Thanks,
Marissa

- SOC 2: We're currently Type I and expect Type II to complete in Q4 (targeting 2026-11-15). I can share the Type I report today and flag when Type II is final.
- Data types: we'll be sending PII + limited PHI in some flows (hashed identifiers, patient event metadata). We'll confirm exact fields in the questionnaire.

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (SOC 2 / pen test / vendor questionnaire)

Thanks Jacob — helpful. Below is the Redwood standard position and what we can commit to for RDW-2389. Happy to tighten any of these items depending on risk profile.

Pen-test / scanning scope and cadence:
- Automated external vulnerability scans: weekly (authenticated where feasible).
- Internal scanning (if customer requests and provides access): monthly.
- Full external pen test: annually. We can accommodate an additional third-party pen test requested by the customer and will coordinate scope.

Vulnerability management SLAs (time-to-remediation targets once a verified vuln is confirmed):
- Critical: 7 calendar days (mitigation plan + patch/mitigation in place or documented compensating controls).
- High: 30 calendar days.
- Medium: 90 calendar days.
- Low: 180 calendar days.

Report sharing and redaction:
- We can provide our latest pen-test report under NDA. Standard practice is to redact customer-identifying details; we can also provide an executive summary without redaction for faster review.

Attachments: redwood-vuln-management-sla.pdf (process + escalation path)

Next steps I'd propose:
1) I'll send a DocuSign NDA link and the questionnaire for FinHealth to complete.
2) Once NDA is signed we'll share a sanitized pen-test report and a short vulnerability remediation plan template.
3) If FinHealth wants a more aggressive SLA for specific high-risk systems, we can evaluate as part of the procurement conversation.

Would you like us to start with the NDA + questionnaire today?

Best,
Marissa
